Gambit & Partners advises founders in complicated positions. No fireworks, no forced lines: we find the move that improves your worst-placed piece, and then we find the next one.
After 4...Bb7. Comfortable for everyone, which never lasts.
The quiet move. We take the whole position in before touching a single piece.
Claim the centre: what actually makes you money, and what merely makes you busy.
King safety first. Cash, contracts and the two hires that stop the bleeding.
Rooks belong on open files. Quiet accumulating advantages, quarter after quarter.
The prophylactic move everyone skips. Room to breathe before the storm, not during it.
“The threat is stronger than the execution.”
Nimzowitsch · quoted correctly, for once, by consultants
Evaluations after our involvement, engine-checked by reality
Cramped kingside, burn rate with initiative
Two rooks (co-founders) on the same file
Winning position, ten minutes on the clock
Evaluations in expected multiples of invested capital. Past positions are no guarantee of future ones, which is precisely why preparation matters.
